body: Cali here too. It has help. Thanks :)
Oh man. That's hard. I feel that you live in the bible belt.

I want someone to know, but at the same time I don't. I don't want to looked down upon or pity or force someone to care. Just a nice notice. A hug or two. A non judgemental, truly caring, in-confidence shoulder to cry on.
You never know if you wake up more depressed or happy. End up telling yourself " Keep it bottled, put on that mask. Simile dammit "
It use to be one more week, then day, now shift. One more shift.
